en: A vintage color postcard showing a very crowded sandy beach with many sunbathers, striped and solid parasols, and people in modest mid‑20th‑century swimwear. In the background there is a long, narrow wooden pier packed with people, ending in a tall multi‑level diving or observation tower extending out into a calm sea. Small boats and a sailboat are visible offshore. The image has a grainy, slightly faded print typical of older mass‑produced postcards. No visible text appears on the image side.
